messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "immediate-release"
set: ["immediate-release", "Immediate-release tablets", "immediate-release capsule", "immediate-release metoprolol tartrate tablets", "18 hours for immediate-release tablets", "clinical trials of immediate-release tablets conducted", "immediate-release (IR), ages 6 to 11 years", "immediate-release (IR), ages 6 to 17 years", "immediate-release (IR), ages 3 to 5 years", "immediate-release tablets taken three times a day", "immediate-release tablets should be used only if clearly needed", "1% to 3% of people taking the immediate-release tablets", "immediate-release tablets should be given at least 6 hours apart", "if you switch from immediate-release metoprolol to the extended-release form", "do not exceed the maximum single dose of 150 mg for immediate-release tablets", "daily dosage of immediate-release formulations may be divided into three doses per day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "Immediate-release tablets",
    "immediate-release capsule",
    "immediate-release metoprolol tartrate tablets",
    "18 hours for immediate-release tablets",
    "clinical trials of immediate-release tablets conducted",
    "immediate-release (IR), ages 6 to 11 years",
    "immediate-release (IR), ages 6 to 17 years",
    "immediate-release (IR), ages 3 to 5 years",
    "immediate-release tablets taken three times a day",
    "immediate-release tablets should be used only if clearly needed",
    "1% to 3% of people taking the immediate-release tablets",
    "immediate-release tablets should be given at least 6 hours apart",
    "if you switch from immediate-release metoprolol to the extended-release form",
    "do not exceed the maximum single dose of 150 mg for immediate-release tablets",
    "daily dosage of immediate-release formulations may be divided into three doses per day"
  ],
  "alias": "immediate-release tablets"
}
